_readme: FULL BRAND KIT. Copy to brand-motion/brand/<slug>.json and replace every <...>. The first block (name … rules) is what the video engine needs; the identity sections after it are optional but make the brand book, DESIGN.md and briefs complete. Keys starting with _ are notes; delete them when done.
name: <Brand name, exact casing>
tagline: <Short end-card line, max 5 words, or empty string>
url: <domain.com shown on end card, or empty string>

voice.case: <upper | sentence | lower>  — how on-screen copy is set
voice.cta: <call to action, e.g. Order now / Try free / Visit us>

palette._roles: Required roles. Values are hex/rgb. A role may alias another role by name (e.g. "onPrimary": "bg").
palette.bg: <HEX light/neutral canvas — end cards and breathers>
palette.primary: <HEX hero brand colour — the colour people would name the brand by>
palette.accent: <HEX pop colour used sparingly: hearts, dots, highlights, price>
palette.dark: <HEX deepest tone — kinetic-type openers, frames, borders>
palette._chapters: Optional. 3–5 background colours the video rotates through, one per chapter/scene (Fresco/IKEA style). Must each have readable text with ink or onPrimary.

scale._note: Font size as a fraction of the frame's SHORT side. Defaults shown; only change if the brand's type is unusually wide/narrow.

logo.src: <path/to/logo-on-light.png|svg, relative to this file — or empty string to use the wordmark>
logo.wordmark: <Text fallback if no logo file, e.g. BRAND>
logo.color: <role for the wordmark fallback, e.g. primary>
logo._clearSpace: Minimum empty space around the logo, as a multiple of logo height.

shape._language: circles = Fresco/Spotify discs & semicircles; rounded = pills & soft rects; sharp = blocks & bars; organic = flowing lines & blobs
shape.motif: <the ONE signature graphic device that recurs, e.g. 'flowing line with a heart tip', 'segmented bar', 'wing pair', 'sound-wave arcs'>

motion._energy: calm = 0.7–1.0s moves, soft easing, 3–4s scenes. balanced = 0.5–0.7s, 2–3s scenes. punchy = 0.25–0.45s, overshoot, 1–2s scenes, beat-cut.
motion.signatureTransition: <cut | wipe | iris | push | cover | shrink | flash | zoom>

layout._safe: Margin on every edge as a fraction of the short side. Keep text and logo inside it.

do: <brand rule, e.g. 'always end on logo over bg for ≥2s'>
dont: <brand rule, e.g. 'never put primary text on accent'>

contact._note: Only real details. Shown on end cards and the brand book footer.

strategy.promise: <what every customer can count on, ≤ 10 words>

sound.sonicLogo: <the short audio sting on the logo>

paletteUsage._note: Approximate share of a layout each role should cover; sums to 100.

motionPrinciples: <3-5 one-line rules, e.g. 'Arrive with a soft overshoot, leave faster than you came'>
